Some nights, the distance feels heavier than the whole world.

I scroll through your photos, and my heart reaches for you, but all it finds is a screen.

I miss your laugh. I miss your voice. I miss the way you say my name.

I look up at the same sky as you and quietly whisper that I’m yours.

You are the reason I smile at my phone like a fool, and the reason I believe in us.

Wait for me, kutty. One day soon there will be no screen and no miles, only me running to you, and I’ll never let go.

I miss you more than words can hold.
I love you, kutty.
